items.item_text: Bachelor’s Degree and/or equivalent combination of education and experience
Minimum of 3 years as a project lead in a business/admin unit within a basic science/clinical department or service line
Reporting to the Director of Operations functions as the Program Coordinator for the Division/Unit within the Department(s) of Obstetrics and Gynecology.

Responsible for a wide range of functions, with varying levels of direction received, for a remarkable, research intensive, Academic Unit/Division/Department. Responsible for ensuring the success and efficient operation of this complex academic Unit/Division(s)/Department(s) the strength of its business functions as outlined by the Director of Operations. The Unit/Division (s)/Department(s) has an annual budget of $61.9M, including $ 65M in revenue from clinical services and $2.8M in revenue from sponsored projects. The Unit/Division(s)/Department(s) manages 143 staff members, 62 clinical and research faculty members, and residents and fellows engaged in clinical and research training.
Understanding of the concepts of strategic leadership, planning and change management approaches in a complex environment, preferably a research-intensive medical school/health system.
Understanding of financial planning concepts as it pertains to academic health care, research and higher education.
Ability to demonstrate an entry level of diplomacy in persuading and influencing people at various levels to achieve results.
Ability to identify and analyze pertinent information/data to make and communicate recommendations and decisions.
Ability as a partner to maintain a culture of integrity and accountability.
Ability to serve as a receptive listener and seeks to understand the differing sides of each situation.
